about: Front-door news strip (C10). Bundled with the game and read offline; never fetched. Update notes must be true of the build: each note shows only when its 'requires' gate is met ('v2' = Content 2.0 rules live on a match map, 'layout:<id>' = that map is in the match rotation, null = always). 'version' drives the NEW mark (shown for notes newer than the player's lastSeenVersion).

notes.ko: 새 정문 개장: 게임 시작 한 번이면 지난번 설정 그대로 출발해요
notes.en: New front door: one press on Play starts a match with your last setup

notes.ko: 동전과 주머니 등장: 주운 동전은 우리 차 앞에 쏟아부어야 점수가 돼요
notes.en: Coins and bags: scooped coins only count once you pour them out at your van

notes.ko: 보급 풍선에 뿅망치가 실려 와요. 빈손일 때 돌진 버튼으로 휘둘러요
notes.en: Supply balloons now drop squeaky hammers. Swing one with dash while your paws are free

notes.ko: 새로 뽑을 것들: 동전 ATM, 대왕 돼지저금통, 돈나무
notes.en: New things to uproot: the coin ATM, the giant piggy bank and the money tree

notes.ko: 뚝딱 공사장 개장! 크레인 고양이를 조심하세요
notes.en: Construction Yard is open. Watch out for the crane cat

notes.ko: 반짝 놀이공원 개장: 찻잔 타고 슝, 관람차 금고는 아래에서만 잡혀요
notes.en: Night Funpark is open: ride the teacups, and grab the Ferris-wheel safes at the bottom
